text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, now that you mention it, the 
Fan Appreciation Festival will be here 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: It is an event I value above all else.
choice_data_list:
Because it's such a precious opportunity 
to connect?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That is part of it, too, but... it is an 
opportunity to proudly act as a knight 
before everyone each year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, we've presented heavy dramas 
set in royal castles... but what should we 
do this year?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A serious, dramatic play... I'd like to 
see that too, but once in a while..."
choice_data_list:
I'd like to see something a bit simpler 
too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Something simple... —Understood. Then this 
year, we shall...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I thought you might enjoy a more modern 
tale. Our circle of connections has 
expanded, making it easier to assemble a 
cast."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of the event. The 
performance that began was...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This labyrinth... has completely turned 
into a den of monsters... And at the 
deepest level—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Dia-san, the Demon King is reviving, isn't 
he?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we must stop them at all costs. The 
four of us together.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You two, make sure to stall them properly. 
If the monsters come over here, it'll 
disrupt my chanting.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Leave healing injuries to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fantasy RPG-style play. The mage played 
by the young witch Sweep Tosho. The healer 
played by the Yamato Nadeshiko, Grass 
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The swordsman is the Satono family's lady, 
Satono Diamond. The knight is Durandal. It 
seems this party of four will take on the 
labyrinth.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Now, let us proceed. Follow after me!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Dia-san, why on earth would you open an 
obvious fake treasure chest?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because... jinxes just make you want to 
break them, don't they...? Ugh, I need 
magical backup...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll blow every last one 
of them away! Grass, take care of treating 
them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, my? Friend or foe alike, you say? 
That's quite troublesome~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The free-spirited party rolled right 
along. But just then...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! Someone is approaching from up 
ahead. This presence...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This is quite a formidable foe! Everyone, 
be careful not to let your guard down."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Quite a formidable foe... Could it be a 
demon? Just what kind of monster could it 
be...?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*gulp* A troll? A salamander? Or could it 
possibly be... a dragon?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As everyone stared into the darkness, what 
appeared was—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Moo-oo-ooh! I'm gonna take you down~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh, what are you... doing...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's a minotaur~ I like milk, so I 
thought this would be good...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-It's a little embarrassing, but... 
MOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Appearing in the role of the Minotaur was 
the good-natured Umamusume, Dantsu Flame. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hoppity-hop, hoppity-hop! I'm a hopping 
vampire, pyon♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
O-O-Oh my! Umamusume adventurers! Could 
this be... the perfect chance to bask in 
their preciousness?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next to come out as a Jiangshi was 
Agnes Digital, who loved Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If they stand in our way, we simply cut 
them down. Let's go, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, Durandal-san! Twinted Sword!

text_block_list.name: Duran & Dia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!! Teyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooo!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans were overjoyed by the magnificent 
combo move. And so, the adventure was a 
success…….

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Sir Knight Durandal, thank you very much 
for the holy light reward earlier~."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally stanning this Jiangshi! I'll 
follow her anywhere, whether it's on turf 
or dirt!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And with that, next up is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Let's meet at the Yasuda Kinen! I'll be 
sure to bring an autograph board too!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh... The 'Yasuda Kinen'...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, yes. I was hoping we could run in a 
race together sometime.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if it's the Yasuda Kinen, I'm planning 
to run in it too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to do moo-ch better this time and 
stand right in the middle of the 
colosseum.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Dants-san, even you...? Very well. I shall 
neither run nor hide.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"The continuation of this story will be at 
the Yasuda Kinen! Everyone, please come to 
the venue and see it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)
choice_data_list: A promo plug, of all things!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't think this would double as an 
announcement for the next race. Like 
this..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital and Dantsu Flame ended up 
facing off on the racetrack as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Encore! Encore!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh, an encore? I haven't prepared 
anything like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-This crazy level of virality... Um, in 
that case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd got so pumped up that the fans 
are demanding an encore. The question is 
how to handle this...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, Durandal! Let's ad-lib 
the classic routine.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The usual classic?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Knights have classic tropes, so we'll 
just do a light take on that!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see... Just as expected of you, 
Digital-san. Now, tell me how I should 
act! Give me your directions!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, an impromptu encore performance 
began.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, I let my guard down... To think I'd 
be surrounded on my way back to the 
castle.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Somehow... I have to escape...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Muhyahyahyahya, you can't run away now, 
Sir Knight of the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Be good and obey Jiangshi Digi-tan.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Kuh, I will—never yield!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As if I would ever give up. No matter how 
cornered I may be.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Resistance is futile, futile, futile. You 
shall now be taken away to the Castle of 
Hell...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You shall spend the rest of your days 
devoted to me, worshiping me, and having 
all your needs catered to effortlessly!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—!? Attentive to every little detail, you 
say!? Such a humiliation...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Wouldn't that actually... be not so 
bad...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Far from just 'not bad', it's the supreme, 
peak life♪ Now, go ahead and order me to 
do anything!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: What part of that is a Hell Castle?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (OOF!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An abrupt fantasy comedy sketch. Thanks to 
the duo's bewildering performance, the 
audience was reasonably entertained.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If it has come to this... I suppose we 
have no choice but to perform the scene 
after returning to the castle.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"The knight Durandal returns to the castle 
alone to report the details to the King. 
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You shall receive praise from the King!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see, an afterword/epilogue, is it? That 
sounds like a fine idea.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Not just regular praise, either! It needs 
to be over-the-top! Excessive! Relentless 
praise!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Not that it matters, but why are you 
puffing and huffing like that?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin, then. The role of the King 
is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, please come up to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a word of protest allowed, I was 
dragged right up onto the stage.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, we have somehow managed to 
prevent the Demon King's resurrection.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
How did you find my performance this time 
around?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! Is that so, is that so! If 
you're pleased, then nothing could make me 
happier!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, I also wiped out the 
monsters lurking in the labyrinth.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"And also, I rescued the troubled 
townsfolk around the labyrinth."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: My party members were jumping for joy too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I felt the story might have been 
exaggerated a bit, but I decided to heap 
praise on her anyway."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, I'm... being praised so much... This 
encore is simply the best...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(It's not often Trainer-dono praises me 
this much...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, if only time would stop... Just stay 
like this for a little longer...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showered in endless praise, Durandal 
looked truly, utterly happy as she basked 
in the moment.
